name: GetHired
one_liner: A public job marketplace run as a live auction — candidates and companies bid for the top spot in their category, starting at $1.
notes: Re-homed 2026-08-24 from the claude/indeed-lol-job-auction-gzzsnr branch of hamza-s-digital-twin into its own private repo. Next: Postgres migration (SQLite will not survive Vercel serverless) + full mobile pass, then deploy to gethired.lol.

launch.state: gethired.lol live on Neon + Stripe, one real paid bid placed end to end from a phone (source: bid_events where amount_paid_cents > 0)

validation.state: first bid from someone who is not Hamza — that person is validation conversation #1 (source: bid_events joined to users)

traction.state: 10 paid bids from >=5 distinct accounts, OR one category where the top spot changes hands twice (source: bid_events)
traction.on_fail: run the 5 validation conversations as a post-mortem, then kill or re-aim

pmf.state: a category stays contested without prompting — >=8 paid bids/month for 3 straight months (source: bid_events)
